name: Vinay Pratap Singh
headline: AI & Cloud Architect | Agentic AI, Azure & Enterprise Platforms
summary: AI and cloud architecture professional with 14 years of enterprise delivery experience. Designs Azure and GenAI solutions with evaluation, observability, and governance, while leading teams through architecture and delivery trade-offs. Combines hands-on engineering with AI enablement and technical leadership.

expertise.title: Cloud & Enterprise Platforms

experience.title: Technical Lead / Architect
experience.summary: Architecture and delivery across enterprise and government engagements in automotive, manufacturing, insurance, CPG, payroll, energy, and the public sector.
bullets: Owned solution design and technology selection; led cross-functional Agile teams of 6–10 engineers and managed executive stakeholder relationships.
Applied AI evaluation and observability across multiple projects; guided security, governance, performance, cost, and delivery-risk decisions.
Provided technical leadership and cross-team influence across 40+ engineers on delivery and reliability work for a connected-vehicle platform.

experience.title: Technical Lead
experience.summary: Contributed to the architecture and development of an AI-assisted hiring platform within a 20-member engineering team.
bullets: Contributed React.js interfaces alongside backend services, model integrations, API contracts, and interview data flows.
Supported bias-aware evaluation workflows and secure handling of multimodal interview data.

experience.title: Senior Analyst
experience.summary: Progressed from developer to senior analyst over eight years, delivering enterprise web and integration solutions across manufacturing, retail, and services.
bullets: Owned delivery of client-facing platforms on .NET, Azure, and SQL; standardised REST API and microservices patterns.
Mentored junior engineers and led technical delivery across concurrent, multi-team engagements.

projects.title: Invoice Intelligence & Audit Automation
projects.summary: Multi-agent invoice and audit processing with SAP integration across two business units.
projects.role: Architecture and delivery lead, from pilot to production.
approach: Used multi-agent workflows with SAP integration and in-flight document processing without persistent document storage to address security and compliance requirements.
Combined Azure OpenAI, Document Intelligence, Azure Functions, and Python.
outcomes: Processed 200–400 invoices/day across two business units.
Reported 3× faster processing and improved audit turnaround.

projects.title: Governed Data & Services Marketplace
projects.summary: Secure data migration and a reusable, governed data-services marketplace for two government entities.
approach: Migrated approximately 6 GB of enterprise data from Informatica Cloud to SQL platforms integrated with Microsoft Purview.
Implemented lineage tracking, access controls, and ongoing controlled data access.
outcomes: Enabled a governed, reusable data-services marketplace for two government entities.

projects.title: Procurement Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: RAG-based procurement intelligence for approximately 300 users across approximately 20,000 documents.
projects.role: Architecture and delivery; evaluated fine-tuning versus RAG trade-offs.
approach: Delivered document intelligence, contract comparison, issue detection, and renewal workflows using RAG on Azure AI Foundry.
Evaluated fine-tuning versus RAG to balance model accuracy against retrieval cost.
outcomes: Enabled approximately 300 users to work with approximately 20,000 procurement documents.
Improved discoverability and supported faster approvals and reduced manual review.

projects.title: Plant Operations & Knowledge Assistant
projects.summary: AI-powered Teams assistant supporting approximately 50 plants operating four shifts per day.
approach: Enabled document-driven knowledge access, event-driven speech-to-text, alerts, and workflow initiation in Teams.
outcomes: Supported approximately 50 plants across four shifts per day.
Improved operational responsiveness, issue resolution, and access to knowledge with less supervisor dependency.

projects.title: Enterprise Email Data Ingestion
projects.summary: Compliance-driven email ingestion proof of concept with a scope of approximately 20,000 mailboxes.
projects.role: Delivered the ingestion solution and proof-of-concept architecture.
approach: Used Microsoft Graph Data Connect to address privacy and regulatory requirements.
Designed the proof-of-concept architecture for enterprise-wide reuse.
outcomes: Established a reusable proof-of-concept ingestion approach for an approximately 20,000-mailbox scope.

projects.title: Claims Summarisation & Validation
projects.summary: AI-assisted claim summarisation and validation for a global insurance broker.
projects.role: Delivered AI summarisation and validation workflows.
approach: Applied standardised, reusable AI patterns to claim summarisation and validation.
outcomes: Improved summarisation time, accuracy, and consistency while maintaining enterprise reliability.

projects.title: Connected Vehicle Platform
projects.summary: Continuous delivery, production stability, and support for a global ecosystem serving 20M+ vehicles and approximately 2M telemetry messages/minute.
projects.role: Delivery and reliability leadership, with technical influence across 40+ engineers.
approach: Managed platform updates, production support, telemetry-driven monitoring, and incident management across global regions.
Worked with IoT Hub, Azure Data Explorer / Kusto, Service Fabric, Datadog, and Azure Functions.
outcomes: Supported delivery and reliability for an ecosystem serving 20M+ vehicles and approximately 2M telemetry messages/minute.
Provided technical leadership and cross-team influence across 40+ engineers.

projects.title: Enterprise HR AI Assistant
projects.summary: Enterprise HR assistant built with Microsoft 365 Agents SDK for employee questions about policies, benefits, and compliance.
approach: Built the conversational interface with Microsoft 365 Agents SDK and grounded responses in enterprise knowledge bases using RAG.
outcomes: Enabled employees to query HR policies, benefits, and compliance information through natural language.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Hiring Platform
projects.summary: React.js-based enterprise interviews and assessments with AI-assisted evaluation and on-demand video/audio workflows.
projects.role: Architecture and development contributor within a 20-member engineering team.
approach: Combined React.js interfaces with backend services, model integrations, and API contracts for interview and assessment workflows.
Supported secure handling of concurrent multimodal interview sessions.
outcomes: Delivered backend capabilities for enterprise interviews and assessments.

projects.title: Agentic Knowledge & Support Platform
projects.summary: A reusable support assistant pattern using Microsoft 365 Agents SDK, grounded retrieval, tool-driven workflows, and an Agent Governance Toolkit.
projects.role: Architecture capability illustration, presented independently of any customer implementation.
approach: Separate the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK conversation interface from a replaceable reasoning engine, combining knowledge retrieval with bounded, multi-step workflows.
Keep the knowledge base current through incremental ingestion and durable background synchronization.
Apply the Agent Governance Toolkit alongside scoped retrieval and managed identity, with conversation state, tool-level tracing, and offline evaluation.
outcomes: Illustrates agent evaluation, observability, conversation state, and knowledge synchronization.
Demonstrates an end-to-end architecture for grounded assistance and structured support triage without claiming customer-specific results.

leadership: Led and contributed to Microsoft's AI Apprentice and AI Mastery programmes, designing curriculum and delivering sessions for 80+ engineers and consultants across 10 cohorts.
Delivered AI project-readiness training to 120+ participants.
Delivered Tech/Delivery Lead Readiness sessions and designed foundational Python and AI project-readiness skilling programmes.
Mentors developers and aspiring technical leads; recurring speaker on Azure AI, GenAI architecture, RAG, and Copilot extensibility.

education.detail: Study includes deep neural networks, mathematical foundations for machine learning, and practical model training, fine-tuning, and evaluation with PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers.
Foundation in computer science, software engineering, algorithms, and system design.
